How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Ropar Senior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar Senior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Structural Engineering or allied branch with 2 years of experience, or a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or allied branch with 4 years of experience, or a Diploma in Civil Engineering or allied branch with 6 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Project Assistant position ranges from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you follow the application procedure outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Ropar Senior Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: IIT Ropar is located in Rupnagar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job position.
